{{Short description|Norwegian theoretical chemist and professor}}
'''Trygve Helgaker''' (born August 11, 1953, in [[Porsgrunn]], [[Norway]]) is professor of chemistry, Department of Chemistry, [[University of Oslo]], Norway.

He was inducted into the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]] in 2004<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.dnva.no/c26848/artikkel/vis.html?tid=26857|title=Norske medlemmer|publisher=Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters|access-date=2 September 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070715142138/http://www.dnva.no/c26848/artikkel/vis.html?tid=26857|archive-date=15 July 2007}}</ref> and the [[International Academy of Quantum Molecular Science]] in 2005.

He has written more than 200 scientific papers, and the book, ''Molecular Electronic-Structure Theory'' (Trygve Helgaker, [[Poul Jørgensen (chemist)|Poul Jørgensen]], and Jeppe Olsen, Wiley, Chichester, 2000). He is one of the main authors of the [[DALTON]] program.
